name: Motorcycle I
description: Generally refers to motorcycles with a displacement of more than 400cc. Motorcycles are called motorcycles in Taiwan, motorcycles in Hong Kong, and motorcycles in mainland China. It is a two-wheeled or three-wheeled vehicle driven by a car, with the front wheel steering controlled by the handle. It is light and flexible, and travels quickly. It is widely used for patrolling, passenger and cargo transportation, etc., and is also used as a sports equipment. When riding a heavy motorcycle, you must wear protective gear and a helmet to protect your life.
